product.name: Application Performance Monitoring (APM)
product.description: A tool to monitor and troubleshoot application performance by collecting and analyzing telemetry data such as metrics, traces, and logs.

product.name: Distributed Tracing
product.description: Tracks user requests across multiple services to identify performance bottlenecks and trace the flow of operations in distributed systems.

product.name: Log Management
product.description: Ingests, searches, and analyzes logs from various sources at scale to support troubleshooting and monitoring.

product.name: Metrics and Dashboards
product.description: Provides infrastructure monitoring, custom metrics collection, and configurable dashboards for visualizing telemetry data.

product.name: Exceptions Monitoring
product.description: Automatically records exceptions with stack traces and linked span data to aid in debugging and error analysis.

product.name: Alerts Management
product.description: Enables creation of actionable alerts based on telemetry data, delivered through preferred notification channels.
